\section[\texorpdfstring{\ur{ٹائم} \ur{ٹیبل} (ṭāim ṭebal)}{ٹائم ٹیبل (ṭāim ṭebal)}]{\ur{ٹائم} \ur{ٹیبل} (ṭāim ṭebal) — a timetable}

\label{lesson:UR-C146-taim-tebal}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Urdu for a plan, then the Urdu for to decide.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ur{ٹائم} \ur{ٹیبل}}
\textbf{\ur{ٹائم} \ur{ٹیبل}} — \emph{ṭāim ṭebal} — \textquotedblleft{}a timetable\textquotedblright{}. Read the board: \textbf{\ur{بس}: \ur{آٹھ} \ur{بجے}} — \emph{bas: āṭh baje} — \textquotedblleft{}Bus: eight o'clock.\textquotedblright{} The bus leaves at eight, so be there before eight.

\section[(dialogue)]{Looking back — a first pass}

\label{lesson:UR-R146-first-pass-looking-back}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for an advert and a receipt.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} recently, already, the past, last, to happen
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Recently? (\textbf{\ur{حال} \ur{ہی} \ur{میں}}, \emph{hāl hī meṅ}.) Already? (\textbf{\ur{پہلے} \ur{سے}}, \emph{pehle se}.) The past? (\textbf{\ur{ماضی}}, \emph{māzī}.) Last? (\textbf{\ur{گزشتہ}}, \emph{guzashtā}.) To happen? (\textbf{\ur{پیش} \ur{آنا}}, \emph{pesh ānā}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Looking ahead and reading signs — a second pass}

\label{lesson:UR-R146-second-pass-looking-ahead-and-reading-signs}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for the future and next.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item the future, next, soon, a plan, to decide
  \item a timetable, a notice, rent; a fare, an advert, a receipt
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
The future? (\textbf{\ur{مستقبل}}, \emph{mustaqbil}.) Next? (\textbf{\ur{آئندہ}}, \emph{āindā}.) Soon? (\textbf{\ur{جلد} \ur{ہی}}, \emph{jald hī}.) A plan? (\textbf{\ur{پروگرام}}, \emph{progrām}.) To decide? (\textbf{\ur{طے} \ur{کرنا}}, \emph{tai karnā}.) A timetable? (\textbf{\ur{ٹائم} \ur{ٹیبل}}, \emph{ṭāim ṭebal}.) A notice? (\textbf{\ur{نوٹس}}, \emph{noṭis}.) Rent; a fare? (\textbf{\ur{کرایہ}}, \emph{kirāyā}.) An advert? (\textbf{\ur{اشتہار}}, \emph{ishtihār}.) A receipt? (\textbf{\ur{رسید}}, \emph{rasīd}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
